title: Antilochus protects Menelaus
intro: Menelaus and Antilochus fight together. Dual endings track the paired fighters, corpses, and horses.

notes.text: βαίνω, go: unaugmented 3sg root aor. πρόμαχοι, front-rank fighters; διά + gen, “through the front ranks.”
κορύσσω, arm: perf mid/pass ptc nom sg; αἶθοψ, gleaming / fiery: dat sg; “armed in gleaming bronze.”
σείω, brandish: pres act ptc; ἐγχείη, spear (acc sg).
ὀτρύνω, urge: unaugmented 3sg impf. δαμείη: 3sg 2aor pass opt of δάμνημι, “so that he might be killed.” Ares intends Menelaus' death.
“He feared greatly for the shepherd of the host”; δίω, fear: unaugmented 3sg impf; περί intensifies, dat marks the person feared for.
“Lest he suffer some harm”; πάσχω, 3sg 2aor opt, stem παθ-.
ἀποσφάλλω, frustrate / rob of: 3sg aor opt; σφας acc pl, the Greeks; gen πόνοιο, “rob them of [the fruit of] their toil.”
ὀξυόεις, pointed / sharp: acc neut pl with ἔγχεα. ἔχω: unaugmented 3dual impf.
μέμονα, be eager: perf act ptc nom dual; + inf “eager to fight.” Menelaus and Aeneas are the pair here.
ἄγχι, close by; παρίστημι, stand beside: unaugmented 3sg impf mid.
μένω, stand one's ground: unaugmented 3sg aor. περ with ptc, concessive: “swift fighter though he was.”
φώς, man / warrior: acc dual (not φῶς, light); μένω pres ptc acc dual. The two are now Menelaus and Antilochus.
ἐρύω, drag: 3pl aor act; “dragged the bodies into the Greek host.”
“They laid the two hapless men…”; τώ + δειλώ acc dual, objects; βάλλω unaugmented 3dual 2aor, subject the rescuers.
αὐτώ nom dual; στρέφω aor pass ptc nom dual, “having turned”; μάχομαι unaugmented 3dual aor mid, “fought.”
αἱρέω, slay: unaugmented 3dual 2aor. ἀτάλαντος, equal / a match for, + dat Ἄρηϊ.
ἀρχός, leader: acc sg. ἀσπιστής, shield-bearing warrior: gen pl -άων.
Famed for the spear; δόρυ + κλειτός.
ἵστημι, stand: perf act ptc acc sg, uncontracted ἑσταότα. νύσσω, stab: 3sg aor.
κληΐς, collarbone: acc sg; τυχέω, hit / strike: aor act ptc nom sg, “hitting the collarbone.”
ἡνίοχος, charioteer (ἡνία, reins, + ἔχω); θεράπων, attendant: acc sg.
ὑποστρέφω, turn back: 3sg impf. μῶνυξ, single-hoofed / solid-hoofed: acc pl.
χερμάδιον, hand-sized stone: dat sg, instrument. ἀγκών, elbow: acc sg; μέσον, “in the middle.”
τυγχάνω, hit: 2aor act ptc nom sg; compare the related τυχήσας at 579.
“Reins white with ivory”; ἡνία neut pl; ἐλέφας, ivory: dat sg (material / ornament).
χαμαί, to the ground; κονίη, dust: dat pl. πέσον = ἔπεσον, 3pl 2aor of πίπτω.
ἐπαΐσσω, rush upon: aor ptc. ἐλαύνω, strike: 3sg aor. κόρση, temple / side of head: acc sg.
ἀσθμαίνω, gasp: pres ptc. εὐεργής, well-made: gen sg with δίφρος, chariot.
κύμβαχος, headlong / head foremost. βρεχμός, crown of head: acc sg; “on his head and shoulders.”
δηθά, long / for a long time. ἵστημι: 3sg plup act, “stood fixed” in his head-first fall.
τυγχάνω, meet with / fall into: unaugmented 3sg 2aor + gen; ἄμαθος, sand (fem), gen sg -οιο.
“Until the two horses struck and threw him down”; ἵππω nom dual; πλήσσω aor ptc nom dual; βάλον 3pl 2aor, dual → plural shift.
ἱμάσσω, lash: 3sg aor (from ἱμάς, strap). ἐλαύνω, drive: 3sg aor; τούς = the horses.
